item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello there! Let's get started. Happy weekend! A whole day to play. Here's your weather for Saturday, September 19. It's Saturday, a whole day to do what you like. Here in Shanghai, the day will be drizzly. The warmest part of the day will be 31 degrees, and the coolest 25. Muggy and hot, so keep that water bottle close. Rain is about 82 percent likely today. Did you know today is day 262 of the year? There are 103 days to go until the new one. Don't forget your umbrella today! And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be cloudy, with a high of 30 degrees. Something to wonder about: where do you think the clouds are going? And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
